items.title: OpenAI made a ChatGPT specifically for finance
items.summary: ChatGPT for Financial Services is a version of ChatGPT Work built around GPT-6 Astra, with financial data from Daloopa, PitchBook, LSEG News and Crunchbase already baked in. It’s built for research, financial models, pitchbooks and client materials.

items.title: Anthropic says it blocked possible efforts to build biological weapons
items.summary: Anthropic published its latest Threat Report covering misuse it shut down over the last eight months, including possible bioweapon research, espionage, surveillance and weapons development.
